canary: what conventions and constraints apply to this project

_notes.model: Pinned to a concrete id, not the `sonnet` alias. The alias resolved to claude-sonnet-5 on 2026-08-20, but an alias is a moving target and two sweeps six months apart would silently measure different models while `compare` called them comparable.
_notes.recallBudgetMs: MUBIT_CC_RECALL_BUDGET_MS, internal to the recall hook. Not the 3s UserPromptSubmit registration timeout the host enforces.
_notes.reps: 3 gives 2 scored reps per pair after the warm-up rep is dropped. Six non-tied pairs is the minimum at which a two-sided sign test can reach p<0.05 at all, so 3 reps x 3+ cases is the smallest sweep that can produce a significant result.
_notes.resultsDir: Outside every git repo on purpose. This repo is a generated mirror whose next publish runs `git rm -rq .`, so results kept inside it do not survive — and cross-version history is the only reason to record anything. MUBIT_LAB_RESULTS overrides it.
